'''Baasen Ray''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and a one-time partner of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After Solo joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Ray became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and pursued the bounty placed on Solo's head by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Ray tracked down Solo, but joined forces with him to stop the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from obtaining the [[hyperspace nullifier]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed by the extinct [[K'kybak]] species. Ray ultimately sacrificed his life to save Solo during a fight with the Imperial astrocartographer [[Essio Galassian]] on [[Seymarti V]].
